text: Implementing #6905 Linux RPM installed-product lifecycle on fix/linux-rpm-lifecycle-6905. The exact built RPM is exercised through the native RPM database in a digest-pinned Fedora linux/amd64 container: install, payload verification, semantic installed-command smoke, same-version reinstall, external-fixture preservation, erase, and database/filesystem residue checks. The RC assembler admits linux_rpm PASS only from exact package- and container-bound evidence; focused local contracts and self-tests pass.
